fields.name: settlementDate
fields.description: Settlement date for the short interest cycle

fields.name: issueName
fields.description: Company name associated with the symbol

fields.name: currentShortPositionQuantity
fields.description: Total number of shares sold short as of the current settlement date

fields.name: previousShortPositionQuantity
fields.description: Total number of shares sold short as of the prior settlement date

fields.name: averageDailyVolumeQuantity
fields.description: Average daily volume for the settlement cycle

fields.name: daysToCoverQuantity
fields.description: Current short position quantity divided by average daily volume

fields.name: shortInterestChangePercentage
fields.description: Change in short interest from the prior settlement date
